description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier rehabilitation center located in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader committed to excellence in patient care and operational efficiency.The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations, maintaining high standards of quality care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This role requires a leader with a strong understanding of healthcare administration, financial management, and team development.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Join a team dedicated to making a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Strong financial acumen and operational management skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience.
